about_the_game:
Indie, platform jumping, ultra-short RPG. Come and uncover the mystery behind the protagonist's background together!

[Game Features]

  • Simple and intuitive controls

  • Exciting and thrilling gameplay

  • A story full of mysteries

  • A black home page, monochromatic grass, monochromatic characters, text-based tutorials laid out directly, drifting characters, a character that automatically looks to the right, areas almost entirely represented by text alone, a castle you can enter without any guidance, a monochromatic interior of the castle, a second level where you don’t know where to go, lights that don’t change between morning and night, a health bar that isn’t centered, a young hero in the story who shouldn’t be able to fly but does, a chase scene with no sense of urgency, misaligned dialogue boxes, characters that haven’t changed in twenty years…

[Development Team]

Developer: Budai

Art (TBD): Jeannie Cheung

Music: Sara Garrard
